role: @Observable lifecycle state of an active workout (phase, live/finished session, elapsed, target zone, HR source, pause flags, paused-motion ledger, pause timeline, strap notice) plus the PauseTimeline and PausedMotionLedger value types and WorkoutStrapNotice enum.
types: PauseTimeline: struct — wall-clock length of each pause keyed by elapsed second; maps sample offsets back to wall clock
PausedMotionLedger: struct — pedometer/foot-pod distance excluded while paused
toplevel: Stored defaults: phase .idle, elapsedSeconds 0, activeHRSource .strap, isPaused/autoPaused false, fresh PausedMotionLedger and PauseTimeline. Instance is WorkoutRecorder.lifecycle (WorkoutRecorder.swift:39). WorkoutStrapNotice is set by HRArbitration per tick.

units.does: Records an open pause at the given elapsed second and wall-clock time (overwrites any already-open pause). Called from WorkoutSessionLifecycle.pause (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift:734).
Closes the open pause, appending a Span(atElapsed, max(0, now-startedAt)); no-op when no pause is open. Called from WorkoutSessionLifecycle.resume (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift:746).

branches.effect: returns without change; otherwise appends span and clears openPause

units.does: Returns sessionStart + offsetSec + sum of span seconds whose atElapsed < offsetSec. A still-open pause is not counted. Used by WorkoutFinalizer.backfillWorkoutHRFromHealthKit (WorkoutRecorder+Lifecycle.swift:556).
Records pedometer and foot-pod cumulative distances at pause start. Called from WorkoutSessionLifecycle.pause.
Adds the distance each counter moved since the pause began to its excluded total and clears the at-pause markers. Called from WorkoutSessionLifecycle.resume.
Returns max(0, raw pedometer distance - excluded - movement in a still-open pause). Read by the ticker and finalize (WorkoutRecorder+Ticker.swift:502,579; WorkoutRecorder+Lifecycle.swift:149).
Returns max(0, raw foot-pod distance - excluded - movement in a still-open pause).
Returns max(0, now-start) when start is set, else 0. A counter that resets/goes backwards during a pause therefore excludes 0.

branches.effect: ?? fallback 0 (no open pause); otherwise max(0, now - start)
